about: One message from the rider of each of the 50 trips that main/run.sh loads (t-0000 to t-0049), and the questions the extension searches with. Written for the recipe; the trips' zones and fares come from main/run.sh.

messages.t-0000: The app charged me more than the quote it showed before the ride.
messages.t-0001: I left my black backpack on the back seat.
messages.t-0002: The driver waited at the wrong corner. I was across the street.
messages.t-0003: Great ride, the driver was friendly and the car was clean.
messages.t-0004: The pickup pin put me at Terminal 4 departures instead of arrivals.
messages.t-0005: Can I get a receipt with my company name on it?
messages.t-0006: The car smelled strongly of smoke.
messages.t-0007: My phone is still in the car. I think it fell between the seats.
messages.t-0008: Why was there a toll on my fare when we did not take a bridge?
messages.t-0009: I was charged a waiting fee, but my flight was only ten minutes late.
messages.t-0010: The driver took a much longer route than the map suggested.
messages.t-0011: Please tell the driver that I have a wheelchair that needs the trunk.
messages.t-0012: I forgot my keys in the cup holder.
messages.t-0013: The final price was eight dollars above the estimate.
messages.t-0014: I lost a small gray suitcase in the trunk after my airport ride.
messages.t-0015: The driver cancelled after I had waited fifteen minutes.
messages.t-0016: The map sent the driver to my old address.
messages.t-0017: The music was too loud and the driver would not turn it down.
messages.t-0018: I was billed twice for the same trip.
messages.t-0019: There was no child seat, even though I asked for one.
messages.t-0020: My umbrella stayed in the car when I got out in the rain.
messages.t-0021: The price jumped while I was booking. Is surge pricing on now?
messages.t-0022: The driver drove too fast on the highway and I felt unsafe.
messages.t-0023: The driver could not find the building entrance on Prince Street.
messages.t-0024: I want to add a tip. I forgot at the end of the ride.
messages.t-0025: I left a laptop bag on the floor behind the driver.
messages.t-0026: The car that arrived had a different plate from the one the app showed.
messages.t-0027: The air conditioning did not work, on a hot day.
messages.t-0028: Can I change the drop-off address in the middle of the trip?
messages.t-0029: I was charged an airport fee that I did not expect.
messages.t-0030: The driver was polite and helped with my bags.
messages.t-0031: The pickup spot was on the wrong side of the park.
messages.t-0032: My wallet might be in the car. It is brown leather.
messages.t-0033: The ride was cancelled, but I was still charged a fee.
messages.t-0034: I waited forty minutes at the airport and nobody came.
messages.t-0035: The driver asked me to pay cash outside the app.
messages.t-0036: The seat was wet and stained.
messages.t-0037: Can you send me last month's receipts in one email?
messages.t-0038: I left my sunglasses on the back seat.
messages.t-0039: The fare was higher than the quote because of traffic. Is that right?
messages.t-0040: The driver stopped for gas during my trip.
messages.t-0041: The app shows the trip as still in progress, but I arrived an hour ago.
messages.t-0042: The driver went to the hospital's main door. I was at the emergency entrance.
messages.t-0043: I found someone else's scarf in the car. How do I return it?
messages.t-0044: I was charged for a larger car than the one that came.
messages.t-0045: The driver was on the phone for the whole ride.
messages.t-0046: My promo code did not apply to the trip.
messages.t-0047: My headphones fell out of my pocket in the car.
messages.t-0048: The driver refused to take my dog. It is a service dog.
messages.t-0049: Please stop sending me notifications at night.

questions.lost-item: I think I left something in the car.
questions.fare-question: Why did I pay more than the price I was quoted?
